title: Kissed Juicy Indian Chickpeas Chana Masala
description: A comforting and flavorful Indian dish featuring chickpeas in a rich and spicy tomato-based sauce, served with phyllo dough and cooked in a cataplana vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the phyllo dough and cut it into small squares.
In a large pan, heat some oil over medium heat and saute the onion until it is translucent.
Add the chickpeas, garam masala, cumin, and coriander to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the cataplana sauce to the pan and bring to a simmer.
Deglaze the pan with a little water to remove any browned bits.
Assemble the chana masala in the cataplana vessel by layering the phyllo dough, chickpea mixture, and sauce.
Cover the vessel with the remaining phyllo dough and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
